item.title: Linen Closet Organization Ideas: A Simple System for Small Shelves
item.description: A linen closet can look full while still being difficult to use. Towels slide into uneven piles, sheet sets get separated, and the items you use every day somehow end up at the back. A better system starts with the shelves you already have. Measure the space, decide what belongs there, and give each category a simple home. These linen closet organization ideas are designed for ordinary homes and narrow closets where storage space is limited.
